verdict: Spend is up and purchases rose, but return on ad spend dropped sharply.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 35 purchases on $1,482.96 in spend, producing a 4.48x return on ad spend (ROAS) across the full window — a solid baseline. This past week, however, spend rose 33.88% while ROAS compressed 69.84% week-over-week, meaning the increased budget is not yet converting efficiently enough to sustain returns. Purchase volume did tick up 16.67% week-over-week, and a strong day on September 8th (7 purchases across the recent 3-day window vs. 4 in the prior 3 days) shows the audience is still responding — but a zero-purchase day on September 9th signals the campaign needs tighter management. We're reviewing the active campaign's spend pacing and creative this week to stabilize efficiency before adding further budget. Expect clearer purchase-trend data and improved ROAS direction over the next reporting period as those adjustments take hold.
